FIFinderSync.doc: A type to subclass to add badges, custom shortcut menus, and toolbar buttons to the Finder.

FIFinderSyncController.doc: A controller that acts as a bridge between your Finder Sync extension and the Finder itself.

FIFinderSync.doc: A type to subclass to add badges, custom shortcut menus, and toolbar buttons to the Finder.

FIMenuKind.doc: The different kinds of custom menus that the Finder Sync extension can provide.

FIMenuKindContextualMenuForContainer.doc: A shortcut menu created when the user control-clicks on the Finder window’s background.

FIMenuKindContextualMenuForItems.doc: A shortcut menu created when the user control-clicks on an item or a group of selected items inside the Finder window.

FIMenuKindContextualMenuForSidebar.doc: A shortcut menu created when the user control-clicks on an item in the sidebar.

FIMenuKindToolbarItemMenu.doc: A menu created when the user clicks on the extension’s toolbar button.

+defaultController.doc: Returns the shared Finder Sync controller object.

-selectedItemURLs.doc: Returns an array of selected items.

-setBadgeIdentifier:forURL:.doc: Sets the badge for a file or directory.

-setBadgeImage:label:forBadgeIdentifier:.doc: Sets the badge image and label for the given ID.

-targetedURL.doc: Returns the URL of the Finder’s current target.

directoryURLs.doc: The directories managed by this extension.
